Boutique FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I create seasonal collections and promotional discounts?

Yes, you can easily organize products by Winter, Summer, Eid, or Bridal collections, and apply percentage or flat discounts directly at the checkout counter.

Does it print thermal receipts with return policies?

Yes! You can customize your 80mm or 58mm thermal receipts with your boutique logo, exchange policy, WhatsApp helpline, and social media handles.
